assumptions: Anything inferred rather than read. Keep these visible.

signals.platform: Name of the site or system. Optional.
signals.paraphrase: Your own words. Never a verbatim quote, never a username.
signals.languageNote: Optional. The phrasing people reach for, paraphrased.

themes.label: Short label.
themes.statement: The pattern, stated as a sentence about the audience.
themes.counterSignal: What contradicts, limits or complicates this. Or 'none found' plus where you looked.
themes.sampleNote: Optional. What this sample is and is not representative of.

angles.angle: The position, as a sentence. Not a slogan.
angles.underlyingProblem: The problem or desire underneath it.
angles.customerLanguage: How the audience describes this, paraphrased.
angles.whyItMayResonate: The mechanism. Why this lands with this audience now.
angles.rankingRationale: Plain language: why this ranks where it does, including what would drop it.
suggestedFormats: Optional. Formats or channels this angle suits and why.

evidenceGaps: What we would investigate next to firm this up.
